bio: Located in the centre of Fuengirola, but just a few metres from the beach, Charolais is a restaurant serving traditional cuisine with a nod to the Basque country on a menu featuring tapas, “raciones” and dishes for sharing. In fact, you’ll find two adjoining and interconnecting restaurants (Charolais and Charolais Tapas) here, as well as a pleasant terrace. Standout options include the Huelva shrimp “al ajillo”, the tartare of avocado and Carabinero prawns, as well any of its meat or fish dishes....
